states.intent: Weighted guard with small breathing motion; no attack frame.
Short grounded fighter step preserving bottom-center foot contact.
Muay Thai teep with startup, active extension, impact cue and recovery.

fx_policy: FX stays in PAL3 strip; body/material stays in PAL2 strip.

acting_contract.idle: Focused neutral face, closed mouth, eyes on opponent.
acting_contract.walk_step: Focused face with slight tension and eyes tracking opponent.
acting_contract.teep: Effort face with tense jaw, teeth or open kiai, narrowed eyes on active frames.
acting_contract.failure_reason: v002 repeats a static cold expression across idle and high-effort attack poses.
